crossRefs.note: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath…

translations.web: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.
translations.bsb: As I looked on, tendons appeared on them, flesh grew, and skin covered them; but there was no breath in them.
translations.kjv: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath
translations.asv: And I beheld, and, lo, there were sinews upon them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.
